profile.headline: IT Pro 2 - App/Software Developer for the University of Minnesota | MS for Software Engineering | BA and MA in English
profile.summary:
Versatile and mission-driven IT professional with experience spanning full-stack application development, systems administration, and healthcare program management. Currently focused on developing and maintaining enterprise web applications at the University of Minnesota, with prior roles in federal service, higher education, and logistics environments.

Graduate of the University of St. Thomas with an M.S. in Software Engineering and certificates in full-stack development and Agile delivery. Experienced with DevOps practices, accessibility compliance, secure systems design, and data-driven problem solving. Holds active CompTIA Security+ and past credentials including Microsoft Azure Administrator. Also trained as a Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt.

Background includes client system administration, cloud infrastructure, medical operations, and cross-functional program leadership—bringing a unique combination of technical depth and people-centered systems thinking.

positions.title: IT Pro 2 - App/Software Developer
positions.description:
As a mid-level developer on the Custom Application Development team, I support and develop on a portfolio of 20+ enterprise web applications serving six major business units. My work focuses on secure application delivery, infrastructure automation, and long-term maintainability across Ruby on Rails and Java systems.

Key contributions:

- Contributed to large-scale migration from RHEL7 to RHEL9, updating application configurations and Ansible automation to resolve dependency, compatibility, and SELinux enforcement challenges while maintaining system stability.

- Lead development efforts on the Performance Appraisal Tool (PAT), delivering new features, resolving defects, and supporting its progression toward MVP for a critical HR-facing system.

- Drove WCAG 2.1 accessibility initiatives across multiple applications, making architectural and frontend design decisions to improve compliance, usability, and long-term accessibility standards.

- Built and implemented Splunk monitoring dashboards for production systems, improving observability and enabling faster incident response for on-call and product teams.

- Applied DevSecOps practices through AWX (Ansible Automation Platform), maintaining CI/CD pipelines, writing deployment playbooks, and supporting secure credential and infrastructure management.

- Explored and piloted spec-driven development workflows using GitHub Copilot to support modernization efforts and improve development efficiency.

- Collaborated within Agile teams across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to scope work, deliver enhancements, and support reliable application operations.

Over time, I have taken on increasing ownership of feature delivery, accessibility strategy, and operational tooling, contributing to more resilient and maintainable systems across the university’s application ecosystem.

positions.title: IT Pro 1 - App/Software Developer
positions.description:
Joined the Office of Information Technology as a full-stack developer supporting a diverse portfolio of custom web applications. Played a key role in maintenance and greenfield development, emphasizing Ruby on Rails and Java platforms.

Key accomplishments include:

- Co-developed the Performance Appraisal Tool (PAT) from concept to production MVP, helping replace legacy HR systems with a secure, modern Rails application that introduced measurable efficiency gains across multiple business units.

- Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using AWX Ansible, including writing playbooks for automated deployments and maintaining consistent Docker-based development environments.

- Integrated multiple enterprise APIs, including Oracle, Canvas, Boomi, and Cybersource, streamlining key university workflows such as performance tracking, training verification, and injury reporting.

- Enhanced application performance and reliability through direct engagement with infrastructure tools such as Oracle SQLDeveloper, F5 load balancing, and GitHub-based workflows.

- Contributed to frontend design and responsiveness, using Bootstrap, React, and standard HTML/CSS to improve UI clarity and accessibility for end users.

- Supported Agile team delivery, presenting regularly in demos and retrospectives, and helping scope feature development and technical debt remediation for over a dozen active applications.

- Advocated for modern development practices, pushing for Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), accessibility compliance, and better vendor integration processes to future-proof the application stack.

This role provided a solid foundation in scalable software delivery, DevOps collaboration, and public sector application development within a university context.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
Served as the sole network and systems administrator during a critical operational transition, overseeing all infrastructure, security, and server management for the university's IT environment.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

- Managed infrastructure upgrades and vendor coordination for system installation and service continuity, laying groundwork for more sustainable IT operations.

- Oversaw SSL certificate lifecycle, including installation, renewal tracking, and security compliance across critical applications.

- Monitored and maintained network security posture, managing Cisco firewall configurations, Active Directory access policies, and Azure AD sync.

- Configured and managed virtualized server infrastructure using VMware, provisioning application servers for tools like PowerFAIDS.

- Implemented robust backup solutions, aligning local and off-site storage strategies with disaster recovery and institutional data retention policies.

- Handled identity and access management via on-prem Exchange Server and Active Directory integrations with Azure AD for hybrid authentication.

This short-term role emphasized autonomy, hands-on technical execution, and forward-looking infrastructure planning within a higher ed context.
positions.insights: Skills: LAN-WAN · Office 365 Administration · System Administration · Customer Service · Cloud Computing · Microsoft Azure · Network Administration · Communication

positions.title: RGV Fellow
positions.description:
Contributed to the AFVentures Data team under the Department of the Air Force’s innovation directorate, supporting strategic decision-making with custom-built analytics tools and award program evaluations.

Key contributions:

- Developed analytics tooling within Google Cloud Platform, using SQL, BigQuery, and Google Workspace to build keyword search functions and dashboards for identifying high-performing small businesses within SBIR/STTR programs.

- Created dynamic pivot tables and normalized spend datasets, enabling stakeholders to visualize award distributions and assess return on innovation investment across federal and Air Force-specific data sources.

- Participated in proposal evaluation workflows, receiving hands-on training in SBIR/STTR review processes and contributing to funding assessments for both Phase I and Phase II innovation proposals.

- Worked within Agile frameworks, using Kanban boards to prioritize, track, and deliver analytics solutions in two-week sprint cycles.

- Collaborated across units, conducting one-on-one interviews with key personnel and participating in organization-wide meetings to assess data needs and tailor insights accordingly.

- Ensured compliance with federal cybersecurity protocols, managing sensitive information with a focus on handling CUI (Controlled Unclassified Information) securely and within established data governance policies.

This role sharpened my skills in data-driven problem solving, cloud-based analytics, and working within complex federal innovation ecosystems.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Google Workplace · SQL · Google Data Studio · Customer Service · Google BigQuery · Communication

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
Served as a mid-level IT specialist supporting enterprise operations across client systems, user accounts, and network infrastructure. Focused on maintaining system availability, enforcing cybersecurity compliance, and providing end-user support in alignment with DoD and Air Force IT policy.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

- Provided frontline technical support for hardware and software issues across the installation, including data recovery, OS troubleshooting, and resolution of recurring system faults.

- Managed Active Directory environments using DRA and on-prem systems, ensuring correct access permissions through least-privilege principles and lifecycle oversight of user and device objects.

- Configured and deployed Windows client systems via WDS, including baseline imaging, driver support, and hardware lifecycle tracking for fleet-wide refresh planning.

- Maintained cybersecurity compliance through DISA STIG implementation, reviewing at least 25% of all endpoint configurations quarterly, and applying ACAS scan findings to remediate vulnerabilities.

- Supported base-level network operations, coordinating with the Network Control Center and telecommunications teams to install, maintain, and troubleshoot clients, switches, conferencing gear, VoIP systems, VPNs, and remote access tools like Cisco Jabber and VMware Horizon.

- Tracked and implemented MTOs (Maintenance Task Orders) and other policy directives to maintain compliance with evolving security standards and ensure system readiness.

- Documented operational processes, developing SOPs, disaster recovery plans, and knowledge base articles to promote continuity and reduce response times to common issues.

- Improved digital literacy across the unit, creating and distributing training materials to reduce support calls.

This role demanded a balance of hands-on systems administration, cybersecurity compliance enforcement, and user-focused service delivery in a mission-critical environment.

positions.title: Health Services Manager / Aerospace Medical Technician
positions.description:
Held multiple operational and clinical support roles within a primary care and readiness environment, balancing personnel management, medical logistics, compliance, and training responsibilities across the medical group. Held NREMT-basic certification for 8+ years with practical, clinical experience. 

Key responsibilities and achievements:

- Managed the Drug Demand Reduction Program, overseeing urinalysis testing for legal and policy compliance. Responsibilities included sample collection logistics, material procurement, education dissemination, and maintenance of a defensible chain of custody under DoD policy.

- Led the Unit’s Newcomers Program, coordinating orientation, training, and administrative intake for incoming personnel—ensuring smooth transitions from training or prior duty stations into operational assignments.

- Certified Basic Life Support (BLS) instructor, conducting quarterly trainings and ad hoc sessions to maintain readiness across all Unit members, including scheduling and instruction outside of standard duty hours.

- Supported COVID-19 response operations, maintaining NREMT certification and contributing to large-scale point-of-dispensing (POD) events that vaccinated military and federal personnel across the installation.

- Coordinated post-deployment medical processing, organizing and executing physical assessments for over 300 returning service members in under a week.

This role blended clinical, administrative, and training duties in a high-responsibility environment, reinforcing a commitment to operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and service member readiness.

positions.title: Unit program Manager
positions.description:
Served as the administrative and operational backbone of the Unit, managing critical support programs and acting as the principal liaison for personnel and compliance issues across the organization.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

- Functioned as the unit’s subject matter expert for all mandated administrative support programs, including personnel systems, readiness tracking, and training compliance.

- Primary point of contact for personnel management, assisting with military and civilian HR coordination, in-processing, pay, and leave issues.

- Supported manpower resource planning, collaborating with leadership to assess staffing needs, track duty statuses, and maintain accountability across functional areas.

- Collected and analyzed data to support Continuous Process Improvement (CPI) initiatives, contributing to streamlined workflows and higher organizational efficiency.

- Developed and maintained internal procedures and recordkeeping systems, ensuring consistent, compliant administrative operations across a wide range of mission support tasks.

- Oversaw information assurance and cyber readiness, tracking training compliance for computer access, auditing device access, and monitoring physical information system security.

This role demanded a high degree of trust, discretion, and cross-functional communication—serving as the connective tissue between leadership, mission requirements, and the personnel who carried them out.

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
Led small teams in a fast-paced logistics environment, ensuring timely package handling and adherence to operational and safety standards. Balanced labor planning, process oversight, and shift-level performance management.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

- Supervised daily package sort operations, ensuring on-time processing across inbound and outbound shifts while minimizing delays and misroutes.

- Managed and trained hourly employees, assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and coaching team members to meet productivity and safety benchmarks.

- Monitored operational KPIs, adjusting staffing and workflow to address bottlenecks and maintain service-level targets.

- Enforced compliance with safety protocols and company procedures, contributing to a safe, efficient working environment under tight time constraints.

This role sharpened my leadership skills, problem-solving under pressure, and ability to coordinate time-critical operations in a physically demanding, team-oriented setting.
